mapper.select: SELECT c.member_account as memberAccount, c.message as message, c.comment_date as commentDate, IFNULL(m.member_name, '未知会员') as memberName FROM commentary c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_account = m.member_account ORDER BY c.comment_date DESC

SELECT c.member_account as memberAccount, c.message as message, c.comment_date as commentDate, IFNULL(m.member_name, '未知会员') as memberName FROM commentary c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_account = m.member_account WHERE c.member_account = #{memberAccount} ORDER BY c.comment_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commentary (member_account, message, comment_date) VALUES (#{memberAccount}, #{message}, #{commentDate})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM commentary WHERE member_account = #{memberAccount} AND comment_date = #{commentDate}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM commentary WHERE member_account = #{memberAccount} ORDER BY comment_date DESC
